description: Hand-labeled profile pairs for the sidecar eval. Profiles use the app's SharedProfile short-key format (lib/icebreaker.ts). Labels are authored from the text: a label exists only where the pair makes the answer unambiguous. Pairs marked expected_escalated=true are deliberately ambiguous, sparse, or signal-free — the dossier should say so.

conventions.offer_search_X: true iff the person's listed skills directly serve the other's stated search
conventions.shared_interest: exact interest listed by both, or 'none' when nothing is literally shared
conventions.curiosity_gap: the interest listed only by person 1 that is furthest from person 2's world (labeled only when unambiguous)
conventions.omitted: no label for that dimension on that pair — excluded from that dimension's accuracy
